entries.name: The Idolmaster SP Chinese High Resolution Texture Pack
entries.credits: Original pack and texture work by the IMASSP-TL contributors. EmuCoreA normalized the upstream repository into a deterministic PPSSPP ZIP while retaining the upstream LICENSE and README.
entries.description: Chinese high-resolution replacement textures for Perfect Sun, Wandering Star, and Missing Moon. The archive contains textures.ini and the referenced PNG assets only; it does not contain a game image.
entries.license: GPL-3.0 for the source repository; see the included LICENSE and upstream project notice for game asset attribution

entries.name: La Pucelle: Ragnarok PPSSPP HD UI Texture Pack
entries.credits: Original texture project by althonos; fonts and third-party contributions are credited in the included upstream README. EmuCoreA retains the source README, COPYING.md, CHANGELOG.md, and attribution notice.
entries.description: A normalized PPSSPP UI/font replacement subset from the upstream release. The upstream release archive contained nine image assets while its textures.ini referenced additional absent files; this derivative removes only those dangling mappings so the archive validates and loads safely.
entries.license: CC-NC 1.0 as identified by upstream README; non-commercial redistribution only: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/nc/1.0/

entries.name: WipEout Pure HD Texture Pack
entries.credits: Texture project by reTokyo; Sony/Studio Liverpool copyright and trademark notices are retained in the upstream README. EmuCoreA links to the original repository and does not mirror it.
entries.description: UI-focused PPSSPP HD texture project for WipEout Pure and listed demo regions. Redistribution permission is not stated, so this catalog keeps the exact upstream ZIP link only.
entries.license: No redistribution license stated; upstream copyright notice; link-only

entries.name: Peggle Portable HD Texture Pack (PlayStation layout)
entries.credits: Pack by sinceohsix. Peggle trademark and original game assets remain with Electronic Arts; EmuCoreA links to the upstream release and does not mirror it.
entries.description: PPSSPP HD replacement textures for Peggle PSP with the PlayStation controller layout. The upstream archive is preserved as an exact external link because no redistribution license is stated.
entries.license: No redistribution license stated; Electronic Arts trademark notice; link-only

entries.name: Fate/Extra PSP HD Texture Pack
entries.credits: Texture project by Ezehokadrim. The upstream README credits original game rights holders and asks users to credit the author; EmuCoreA links to the original repository and does not mirror it.
entries.description: PPSSPP replacement textures for the US PSP release. The repository contains a root textures.ini and 1,991 image assets, with 200 referenced images absent from the snapshot; its README does not state a redistribution license or permission, so this entry keeps the exact upstream ZIP link only.
entries.license: No redistribution license stated; upstream README requests author credit and reserves original game rights; link-only
